submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, index 1 (Ca0.137 Fe0.701 Mn0.162) gave the highest photocurrent, +1e-8 A. XRD showed a rocksalt-like host phase across the whole library. Index 1 also showed extra reflections that fit hematite (Q≈1.71, 2.34, 2.51, 2.86). Hematite absorbs 2.4 eV light, so it is the likeliest photoactive phase.

rejected.reason: Mn-rich with a second phase that looks like a Mn oxide; measured photocurrent was negative (-4e-8 A), so no anodic photoresponse.
Fe-rich with less Mn and more Ca; measured about 0 A, lower than index 1.
Ca-rich; XRD showed only the rocksalt host phase and no phase likely to absorb visible light. Photocurrent was not measured.
Mid-composition; XRD showed mostly the host phase with only weak traces of hematite. Photocurrent was not measured.
